messages.author: a93fe0f7d78f425e
messages.subject: No output in Main Panel
parts: I am running RStudio on a linux machine I ssh into, and am unable to see any reactive output in the "main panel" in any Shiny App. When I run the example via runExample("01_hello") I get just the sidebar content and main panel title, but no histogram (see attached screenshot). This is consistent across Safari and Chrome,  occurs for Shiny version 0.12.2 and 0.12.0, and is true for all 11 Shiny examples, as well Shiny apps I've written that work on my local machine. I don't see any error messages in my RStudio console. I believe this problem is caused by the old version of R I am running, R 3.1.0. I cannot update my version of R, but wondered if someone could help me come up with a fix to be able to view the reactive output.
